lastCompletedStory.title: Render codex exec approval policy via -c approval_policy=never

nextStoryContext: codexSandboxArgs's non-bypass branch now renders '--sandbox workspace-write -c approval_policy=never' instead of the exec-rejected '--ask-for-approval never'; header doc comment on codexSandboxArgs (src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts ~L346-370) no longer contains the literal string 'ask-for-approval' anywhere in the file (AC4's grep gate). test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts grew a standalone contract-test describe block enumerating codex exec's full accepted-flag surface (codex-cli 0.144.6) and asserting every actor x permissionMode combination's rendered argv uses only those flags -- extend that list if a future story adds a new codex exec flag. Verified live against the actually-installed codex-cli 0.144.6 binary on this machine (not just docs): 'codex exec --sandbox workspace-write -c approval_policy=never -m <model> ...' parses and reports 'approval: never / sandbox: workspace-write' in its session header; 'codex exec --help' lists no '--ask-for-approval' option. Per the story's own notes: a sidecar coherence rebuild (bash scripts/build-release.sh --install + restart sidecar by pid) is required after this ships for a live codex-backed pane to pick up the fix, but that is an operator post-merge step, not part of this story.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed live (not just via WebSearch) that 'codex exec --help' lists -c/--config, -s/--sandbox, -m/--model, --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox, -C/--cd, -p/--profile, -i/--image, --output-schema, --json, -o/--output-last-message, --color, --ephemeral, --oss but NO --ask-for-approval; ran 'codex exec --sandbox workspace-write -c approval_policy=never -m <model> "say hi"' and it parsed argv successfully, printing 'approval: never / sandbox: workspace-write' in its session header before failing later on an unrelated model-availability 400 (unrelated to argv shape).
